cd4bb9a12923dc12d1b5fcc69d7630766f47dd13.title: Cleaner page URLs for QR tools
details: Pages now use simple clean URLs, while existing ?page= links still work.
Footer links, presets, and the default starter URL use the new URLs.

5f26038260f417beb73400e3b9377786c89ca468.title: Clean URL guide added
details: The page map and clean URL behavior are documented.

c3b3b5b9b1e825fb5944856766f7d54a7b38d145.title: Custom measurements and multiline captions
details: Add custom values for numeric settings, including page size and sticker spacing.
